# Configuration

Squeezer reads `squeezer.config.json` from the repository root.

## Options reference

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `budget` | number | 3000 | Output token budget |
| `include` | string[] | `[]` | Extra globs to index |
| `exclude` | string[] | `[]` | Globs to skip |
| `semantic` | boolean | false | Use local embeddings |
| `ollamaUrl` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Embedding endpoint |
| `cache` | string | `.squeezer` | Cache directory |
| `redact` | boolean | true | Mask secrets |
| `maxFileBytes` | number | 2097152 | Skip larger files |

## Example

```json
{
  "budget": 4000,
  "include": ["docs/**"],
  "exclude": ["**/*.snap"],
  "semantic": false
}
```
